newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 9.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 9.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The National Alliance of Hungarian Trade Unions (MSZOSZ) proposes that Laszlo Halmi, a doctor should be appointed as chairman of the health care fund's self-government.
- The largest Hungarian commercial bank OTP encourages its clients who hold only small foreign currency amounts on OTP accounts to liquidate their accounts.

- The director of the National Psychiatry and Neurology Institute said it would be a hard blgw at efforts aiming at decresing the number of suicides if subsidies on drugs fgr depression would be cut as planned.
- Zoltan Gal, Chairman of the Parliament said a 30 percent wage increase for MP's was justified even if the move was criticised sharply.
- Vice-President of the opposition Christian-Democrat People"" Party (KDNP) denied a press report that financial difficulties might compel KDNP to sell its headquarters.
